pages.description: Single-page product or campaign landing pages.

pages.label: Business pages

items.title: Centered offer strip with link
items.description: Slim primary-colored strip with one centered line of offer text and a small link button. Wraps and stays centered on mobile.

items.title: Dark strip with text left and link right
items.description: Dark slim bar with an update on the left and a Read more link on the right. Stacks into two tight lines on mobile.

items.title: Centered logo above menu row
items.description: Elegant header with the logo centered on top and a centered navigation row beneath a fine rule. Collapses to logo plus hamburger on mobile.

items.title: Dark header for dark heroes
items.description: Dark bar with logo left, menu centered and a glowing outline button right. Blends into a dark hero; hamburger and logo only on mobile.

items.title: Header with logo, centered menu and button
items.description: Logo on the left, navigation in the middle and a primary button on the right. On mobile only the logo and a hamburger menu remain.

items.title: App hero with copy, checklist and phone photo
items.description: Headline, three check points and download buttons on the left with a phone mockup photo on the right. Stacks with the photo below on mobile.

items.title: Centered hero on aurora gradient with wave
items.description: Centered eyebrow, headline, text and two buttons on a warm gradient with an aurora glow and a wave divider. Everything stacks and scales down on mobile.

items.title: Dark hero with particles and stats row
items.description: Centered copy on a deep dark background with interactive particles, two buttons and a compact row of animated stats. Stats wrap and center on mobile.

items.title: Fullscreen photo hero with overlay and left copy
items.description: Tall hero over a slowly zooming mountain photo with a dark overlay and left-aligned copy and buttons. Text stays readable and buttons wrap on mobile.

items.title: Luxe serif hero with wide photo below
items.description: Centered serif headline and two buttons on a dark gold-accent canvas, with a wide rounded photo beneath. Photo and text scale cleanly on mobile.

items.title: Split hero with photo
items.description: Headline, supporting text and two buttons on the left; a large rounded photo on the right. Stacks on mobile.

items.title: As seen in row with quote snippets
items.description: An As seen in label over four fictional publication names, each with a one-line quote. Four across on desktop, two on tablet, one column on mobile.

items.title: Trusted by heading with six wordmark grid
items.description: Small Trusted by heading above a six-up grid of muted fictional wordmarks. Three per row on tablet and two per row on mobile.

items.title: Bento grid of mixed-width feature cards
items.description: Two rows of colourful feature tiles in 8/4 and 4/8 proportions with a centered heading; tiles stack full width on phones.

items.title: Centered heading with six-card icon grid
items.description: Centered heading above a grid of six icon cards that reveal in sequence; 3 columns on desktop, 2 on tablet and 1 on phones.

items.title: Dark trio of glowing spotlight cards
items.description: Dark band with a centered heading and three cards that glow at the edge and follow the pointer; cards stack on phones.

items.title: Tabbed feature panels with image and text
items.description: Centered heading above three tabs; each panel pairs a photo with text and a checklist, and panels stack on mobile.

items.title: Three alternating image and text rows
items.description: Three feature rows with a photo and a checklist, alternating sides; each row stacks image-under-text on mobile.

items.title: Large photo beside text with three counters
items.description: Big photo on the left; headline, paragraph and three animated stats on the right. Stacks with the photo on top on mobile.

items.title: Our story split with photo and quote
items.description: Eyebrow, headline, two paragraphs and a signed quote on the left with a tall photo on the right; stacks with photo first on phones.

items.title: Dark band with heading and three stats
items.description: Dark band with an eyebrow and headline on the left and three animated metrics on the right; stacks on phones.

items.title: Four animated counters on a surface band
items.description: Four count-up numbers in a row on a soft surface band with wave dividers; 2 by 2 on phones.

items.title: Four numbered steps in a grid
items.description: Centered heading above four steps with oversized numbers 01 to 04 and short descriptions; 4 columns, then 2, then 1 on phones.

items.title: Sticky step titles with scrolling panels
items.description: Four steps whose titles stay pinned while image-and-text panels scroll past; collapses to a simple stacked list on phones.

items.title: Quote carousel
items.description: One large centered quote per slide with a round portrait and stars; arrows move between three slides.

items.title: Testimonial with large portrait
items.description: Large portrait on the left, big quote with rating, name and role on the right; stacks with the photo on top on mobile.

items.title: Three testimonial cards
items.description: Three review cards with star ratings, quote and a round portrait; lift on hover and stack to one column on mobile.

items.title: Three-tier pricing cards
items.description: Three plan cards with monthly prices and check lists; the middle plan is highlighted with a badge and strong border. Stack on mobile.

items.title: Two plans on dark
items.description: Two plan cards side by side on a dark background with a glowing featured plan and a shared "all plans include" check list below.

items.title: Two-column price list
items.description: A salon or restaurant price list in two columns: item name, dotted leader and price with a short note per row. Stacks to one column on mobile.

items.title: Four-person team grid
items.description: Four team cards in a responsive grid: square portrait, name, role and a one-line bio. Four across on desktop, two on tablet, one on phones.

items.title: Leadership split
items.description: Heading and intro on the left; two leader cards stacked on the right, each with portrait, name, role and bio. Stacks on mobile.

items.title: Centered FAQ accordion
items.description: Centered heading above a five-panel accordion of questions and answers; panels open one at a time and work well on phones.

items.title: FAQ two columns with contact
items.description: Heading, intro and a contact button on the left; six question-and-answer pairs on the right. Stacks on mobile.

items.title: CTA card with photo
items.description: A rounded surface card holding a headline, text and button on the left and a photo on the right; the photo moves above the text on mobile.

items.title: Dark centered call-to-action
items.description: A dark band with a curved top edge, a big headline and one magnetic button, all centered; spacing tightens on mobile.

items.title: Gradient call-to-action band
items.description: A full-width gradient band with floating particles, a centered headline, supporting text and two buttons that stack on mobile.

items.title: Inline newsletter band with sign-up form
items.description: Heading and short pitch on the left, the site email sign-up form on the right, on a soft tinted band. Pick your form in the right column after inserting; stacks on mobile.

items.title: Newsletter card over a photo background
items.description: A centred card on a darkened photo with a heading, short pitch and the site sign-up form. Choose your form inside the card after inserting; padding tightens on mobile.

items.title: Contact details beside a form
items.description: Phone, email and address with opening hours on the left; the site contact form on the right in a card. Choose your form after inserting; stacks on mobile.

items.title: Map with address and opening hours
items.description: A wide map beside the address, opening hours and a directions button. The map uses an address with no API key; it stacks under the details on mobile.

items.title: Photo carousel with captions
items.description: A swipeable carousel of five landscape photos, each with its caption and arrows. Shows one photo at a time on mobile.

items.title: Six-photo grid with hover zoom
items.description: Heading above a three-by-two photo grid. Photos zoom gently on hover and open larger on click; two columns on tablet, one on mobile.

items.title: Latest posts from the blog (dynamic)
items.description: Heading plus the site's three newest published posts in a grid with image, date and excerpt, pulled live from the blog. Shows nothing until the blog has posts.

items.title: Three article cards with view-all button
items.description: Heading with three image cards (photo, title, teaser, read link) and a View all button below. Cards lift on hover; they stack on mobile.

items.title: Four product cards with price and buttons
items.description: Four product photo cards, each with name, price and an Add to cart button linking to the product page. Four across on desktop, two on tablet, one on mobile.

items.title: Wide collection banner with shop button
items.description: Full-width photo banner with a dark overlay, collection title, one line of copy and a Shop the collection button. Left aligned on desktop, tighter padding on mobile.

items.title: Centered footer with social icons
items.description: Centered logo, one-line tagline, round social icons and a small copyright line on a soft tinted background. Works unchanged on mobile.

items.title: Dark single-row footer
items.description: One slim dark row: site title on the left, small links in the middle, social icons on the right. Stacks and centres on mobile.

items.title: Four-column footer with social bar
items.description: Logo and blurb plus three link columns, then a bottom bar with copyright and social icons. Columns stack on mobile.

items.title: Dark tech landing page
items.description: Dark landing page with a particle hero, glowing feature cards, stats band, two-plan pricing and a dark call to action.

items.title: Mobile app launch page
items.description: Launch page for a mobile app: app showcase hero, bento feature cards, numbered steps, quote carousel, newsletter sign-up and a centered footer.

items.title: SaaS product landing page
items.description: Full product landing page: header, split hero, logo strip, icon feature grid, alternating feature rows, stats, testimonials, three-tier pricing, FAQ and a gradient call to action.

items.title: Agency home page
items.description: Home page for a creative or digital agency: gradient hero, press mentions, story split, tabbed services, team grid, gallery and contact call to action.

items.title: Company about page
items.description: About page: full-image hero, company story, stats with picture, leadership, team grid, testimonials and a call to action.

items.title: Consulting services page
items.description: Services page for consultants and firms: split hero, icon service grid, sticky process steps, client quotes, FAQ and contact.

items.title: Contact page
items.description: Contact page with a slim hero band, contact details and form, map with opening hours, FAQ and footer.

items.title: Pricing page
items.description: Pricing page with three plans, a two-plan comparison band, logo strip, testimonials, FAQ accordion and call to action.

items.title: Studio portfolio page
items.description: Portfolio for a photographer or studio: full-image hero, photo gallery, carousel, story, testimonials and a minimal dark footer.

items.title: Restaurant page
items.description: Restaurant or cafe page: elegant serif hero, story, menu price list, gallery, reviews, map with opening hours and newsletter.

items.title: Conference event page
items.description: Event page: gradient hero, numbered schedule steps, speakers grid, stats, ticket pricing, FAQ and venue map.

items.title: Wellness studio page
items.description: Yoga, fitness or clinic page: image hero, alternating benefit rows, instructors, class pricing, testimonials and booking call to action.

items.title: Store front page
items.description: Online shop home: offer bar, collection banner, product cards, feature icons, reviews, blog cards and newsletter.
